name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-inbox
description: Establishes a new repository as a complete, runnable helpdesk application: a Vite + React single-page app with its own navigation rail, a chat screen with message channels and unread counts, a searchable and sortable conversation list, a message thread with a reply-and-note composer and a customer-details panel, plus a contacts directory with filters, a sortable paginated table and a deep-linkable contact detail page. Every screen is composed from @gears-frontx/ui-kit components and semantic tokens, and every conversation, message, contact and user identity is served by the app's own @gears-frontx/api service through a mock plugin rather than by fixture files. Apply this to start a project whose product is a support inbox, a helpdesk, a team chat with channels, a shared team mailbox, a customer-conversation console or a contacts directory: it seeds the whole application - build, lint, test and dependency set included - and needs no other template applied alongside it. Adding further screens to the app it establishes is carried by the skill this template activates in the project, not by applying it again.
